title: SpaceX Stock (SPCX) Rises 5.8% After NASA Moon Base Awards (Nov 9)
summary: SpaceX stock (SPCX) rose 5.81% to $142.07 on Nov 9 after NASA named SpaceX among eight companies in its $10 billion lunar delivery pool.
body_markdown:
## Why SpaceX Stock Rose


Coverage of the session pointed first to NASA. According to[NASA's official release](https://www.nasa.gov/news-release/nasa-awards-moon-base-transportation-technology-science-projects/) dated November 7, the agency selected SpaceX as one of eight companies, alongside Blue Origin, Lockheed Martin and Northrop Grumman, to compete for future lunar surface deliveries under a 10-year contract with a combined maximum value of $10 billion. NASA also selected SpaceX for a Cislunar Communications Deployment Demonstration, under which SpaceX will launch communications satellites aboard a Starship to cislunar space in 2028.


As reported by[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/spacex-rocket-lab-blast-higher-as-nasa-hands-out-10-billion-in-moon-base-awards-164320855.html) , SpaceX added more than $100 billion in market value on Monday and posted its[biggest two-day gain since early October](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/spacex-spcx-stock-news-november-9-2026/) . Yahoo Finance also wrote that Wall Street prices SpaceX less as a lunar trucker than as an AI cloud, and that space stocks rose roughly 20% to 60% from the November 5 close.


A second item came from Texas. Per[Stocktwits](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/spcx-stock-rises-spacex-advances-214647323.html) , which cited a Bloomberg report, SpaceX proposed building, owning and operating a gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility on about 444 acres in the City of Starbase, with an estimated capital investment of about $24 billion for the initial phases. Stocktwits noted that SPCX closed above its June[IPO price](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-an-ipo/) of $135.


## SPCX Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- NASA placed SpaceX in its new lunar delivery pool and selected it for a Starship communications demonstration in 2028, according to NASA.
- SpaceX is widening its AI compute base, including the Starbase project and a multi-year arrangement with Anthropic for capacity at its Colossus sites, as reported by Stocktwits.


### Risks


- The NASA pool selects companies to compete for future delivery missions, and the release gave no dollar value for SpaceX's own work.
- The Starbase plan goes to a December 9 public hearing on a tax abatement and development agreement, and Texas's[incoming Democratic governor](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/democratic-midterm-sweep-fallout-trump-blames-democrats-data-center-and-spacex-pushback/) , Gina Hinojosa, campaigned partly on curbing new data-center construction, per Stocktwits.
- Space stocks have swung sharply: Yahoo Finance noted that an average of nine space stocks more than doubled this year by May 28, then gave it all back, leaving the group down for 2026.
